job_description:
Job Title: AI Engineer (2+ Years Experience)

Location: [City / Remote / Hybrid]
Experience Required: 2+ Years
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview

We are looking for a skilled AI Engineer with around 2 years of hands-on experience in building and deploying AI/ML solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience working with machine learning models, data pipelines, and AI frameworks to develop intelligent applications. You will collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to design scalable AI-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and AI models for production systems.

Work with large datasets to train, evaluate, and optimize ML models.

Build and maintain data pipelines and model deployment workflows.

Implement AI solutions using frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.

Develop APIs or microservices to integrate AI models into applications.

Perform model monitoring, performance tuning, and debugging.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business problems and translate them into AI solutions.

Stay updated with the latest advancements in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

Required Skills

Strong programming skills in Python.

Experience with Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms.

Hands-on experience with frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn.

Familiarity with data processing tools like Pandas, NumPy.

Experience with REST APIs, model deployment, or MLOps tools.

Knowledge of SQL and database systems.

Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
